It may be forthcoming, but as far as you're concerned it's already yours.

Since my little epiphany I have been much more up-beat. Now I believe every word and thought is a command to the higher self. I better make it positive as I want a better life. I've been much more calm/collected since I read that little passage.

Until next week.
